description.zh-CN: 用像素钻石镐挖走编辑器控件，收集掉落物与经验，再把真正的控件放回屏幕。九格快捷栏，1–9 选择；关闭工具状态保留布局，恢复快捷键或停用模组会全部复原。图像与音效均由程序生成。
description.en-US: Mine editor controls away with a pixel diamond pickaxe, collect the drops and experience, then put the real controls back on screen. Nine-slot hotbar, choose with 1–9; hiding the tool keeps the layout, and restoring the shortcut or disabling the mod puts everything back. All images and sounds are generated in code.

label.zh-CN: 开启 / 关闭工具状态

description.zh-CN: 收起工具栏和手持物品，保留已挖走或重新放置的控件。
description.en-US: Hides the toolbar and held item while keeping whatever was mined or placed.

description.zh-CN: 恢复控件原位置，清空掉落物、物品栏和经验。停用模组也会执行恢复。
description.en-US: Puts controls back, clears drops, inventory and experience. Disabling the mod also restores everything.
